title: Photonics
tagline: Optical waves, waveguides and fibres, light sources, photodetectors and optical communication
summary: Light carries most of the world’s data and converts sunlight into electricity. This course treats light as an electromagnetic wave, guides it in waveguides and optical fibres, and covers light-emitting diodes and lasers, photodetectors and receivers, optical communication systems and photovoltaics.

chapters.title: Light as an electromagnetic wave
chapters.summary: Optical plane waves, interference, diffraction, coherence and polarisation.

chapters.title: Dielectric waveguides
chapters.summary: Slab waveguides, guided modes, and the planar optics of integrated photonics.

chapters.title: Optical fibres
chapters.summary: Step- and graded-index fibres, modes, attenuation and dispersion.

chapters.title: LEDs and lasers
chapters.summary: Light emission in semiconductors, light-emitting diodes, stimulated emission and semiconductor lasers.

chapters.title: Photodetectors and receivers
chapters.summary: Photodiodes, avalanche photodiodes, receiver noise and sensitivity.

chapters.title: Optical communication systems
chapters.summary: Modulation, wavelength-division multiplexing, optical amplifiers and system design.

chapters.title: Photovoltaics
chapters.summary: Solar-cell physics, efficiency limits, modules and photovoltaic systems.
